title: Blue Heaven | Charming 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Blue Heaven is a pet-friendly 30A home steps from community pools and beach access, with bikes, balconies, and an easy ride to Seaside and dining.
description_expanded: Blue Heaven Features - Driveway Parking for 2 sedans. RV, trailer, and street parking is restricted - Access to 2 community pools - Chelsea Loop pool is only 70 footsteps from the home and Ryan Street Pool is heated during cooler temperatures from March 1 - December 1. (subject to change by the HOA) - 2-minute stroll to the Ramsgate Beach Access. Beach Service by 30A Shades available at this location - 4-minute stroll to the Eastern Lake Beach Access, one of the rare locations in the world where a brackish lake flows into the Gulf. Sunsets at this location are spectacular - 2-minute bike ride to Greenway Station, with great shopping and dining including Free People, Turbo Coffee, and Canopy Road Café - 2-minute bike ride to The Perfect Pig, a top recommended restaurant on 30A - 12-minute bike ride to shopping, entertainment, and dining in Seaside, or shopping, dining, and entertainment at The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) - Fishing licenses and sports equipment rentals (including fishing gear, kayaks, and YOLO boards for exploring Eastern Lake) available at Yellowfin Ocean Sports, less than a mile from the home - Access to of 4 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - Outdoor Propane Grill on back patio - Balconies on 2nd and 3rd floor - WIFI and cable available - Large Smart TV in living room - Washer/Dryer on 1st floor - Full Kitchen on the 2nd floor, including a drip and k-cup coffee maker - Dining area with seating for 6 plus high-top seating for 6 (3 at kitchen bar and 3 at table behind the sofa) - Concierge services, including bike rentals, grocery delivery, YOLO board rentals, catered beach bonfires, and baby equipment rentals are available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Golf carts are prohibited in the neighborhood per the HOA Welcome to Blue Heaven! Decorated by our team of professional designers, this charming four-bedroom home is the chic beach retreat for which you have been searching. Facing one of two neighborhood community pools and 200 footsteps to the sand! Great location in a quiet neighborhood and a lovely bike ride to Seaside. The main living area is featured on the second floor, including a living room, dining area, balcony, and full-size kitchen. A plush sectional sofa faces the SmartTV. An inviting dining table is available for evening meals with adjoining breakfast bar seating for additional guests. A powder room is available as is a private balcony with seating. Can't you feel the Gulf breezes from here? A king suite and guest room with sleeping for 2 in twin bunks are located on the third floor. The ensuite renovated spa bath includes a dual vanity sink, modern soaking tub, and large walk-in shower. A comfortable seating area and private balcony finish the grand suite. Area Update - Ongoing Enhancements Along 30A The 30A area continues to flourish, with new homes, boutique developments, and community enhancements taking shape throughout our coastal towns. While this progress adds to the long-term beauty and value of the area, occasional construction activity may be present nearby during your stay. Rest assured, the peaceful coastal atmosphere and exceptional comfort of your home remain our top priority.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
